verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's BadgerQL provides a genuine query syntax with examples filtering by tag, class, component, action, and deploy-related properties (occurred.after:'last deploy'), and Insights alarms also run BadgerQL queries — clearly a real query language, not just keyword search. However, evidence never shows explicit 'environment' as a filterable field, and all fault/search endpoints (e.g. docs-19) appear scoped per-project with no documented cross-project search capability. Missing for 10: explicit environment-field filtering, cross-project/global search evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of query behavior.
